content: Amakeerenʼya
Ɨnyarʉbha yɨnʉ nandikirɨ inyɨ Paaurʉ. Inyɨ nɨtaatumirwɨ na abhaatʉ hamwɨ kuswajibhwa na mʉʉtʉ, nawe nitumirwɨ na Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ na Bhaabha Mungu wʉnʉ aaryurirɨ Yɨɨsu kurwa mʉbhaku.
Inyɨ na abhiisirirya abhakɨndichɨtʉ bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bharɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niinyɨ, tʉrabhaandɨkɨra imwɨ abhiisirirya bhʉ ʉrʉbhɨri rwa Garaatiya.
Ɨbhɨgʉngi no omorembe kurwa kwa Bhaabha Mungu, na kʉMʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, bhɨbhɨ na niimwɨ.
Kiriisitʉ akiihurucha igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwɨtʉ, korereke atʉsabhʉrɨ kurwa mʉmabhɨ gʉʉsi gɨ ɨɨsɨ ya nangwɨnʉ. Akakorabhu kʉrɨngʼaana nu ubhwɨndi bhwa Bhaabha wɨɨtʉ Mungu.
Mungu agungibhwɨ kemerano! Garamɨ.
Ɨtareeho Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu ɨyɨndɨ ya amaheene
Nɨrarʉgʉʉra kʉ kʉbha ibhaga isuubhu mʉtangirɨ kutiga Mungu wʉnʉ aabhabhirikiirɨ kʉbhɨgʉngi bhya Kiriisitʉ, na kwichʉrɨra amiija agandɨ ganʉ abhandɨ bhakʉbhɨrɨkɨra Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu.
Amaheene nɨ‑kʉbha ɨtareeho Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu ɨyɨndɨ. Nawe bhareho abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhakʉbhanyaacha na bhareenda kurimirya Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu igʉrʉ wa Kiriisitʉ.
Nawe nangabha wʉmwɨ wɨɨtʉ hamwɨ maraika
kurwa kwisaarʉ, araabharwazɨrɨ ɨngʼana bhʉndɨ na yɨnʉ twabharwaziirɨ, ʉmʉʉtʉ wuyo ihiimwɨ!
Nɨragarʉkɨra kʉgamba, chɨmbu nagambirɨ ribhaga rirya kʉbha, ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi araabharwazɨrɨ ɨngʼana bhʉndɨ na yɨnʉ twabharwaziirɨ, ʉmʉʉtʉ wuyo ihiimwɨ!

Nangʉ, muriiseega nɨramohya kwisiriribhwa na abhaatʉ? Zɨyi, inyɨ nɨramohya kwisiriribhwa na Mungu umwene. Hamwɨ muriiseega nɨramohya kozomera abhaatʉ? Arɨɨbhɨ nangamʉhiryɨ kozomera abhaatʉ, nɨtaarɨ nɨrabha omohocha wa Kiriisitʉ.
Paaurʉ abhirikiirwɨ na Mungu
Abhahiiri bhaanɨ, nereenda momenye kʉbha, Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu yɨnʉ inyɨ nabharwaziirɨ ɨtaruurɨ kʉbhaatʉ.
Na nɨtahɨɨrwɨ na mʉʉtʉ, naabha kwijibhwa na ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi, nawe Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ umwene newe anhumburiirɨ.
Nɨ‑maheene mwigwirɨ chɨmbu naarɨ ribhaga rɨnʉ niitaniirɨ ɨnyangi yaanɨ yɨ Ɨkɨyaahudi. Mwɨzɨ chɨmbu nanyaakiryɨ bhʉkʉngʼu abhaatʉ bha mwisengerero rya Mungu, na kwenda kuriricha kɨmwɨ.
Nɨkahiza abhakɨndichanɨ bhaaru bhɨ ɨsɨɨga yaanɨ ku ukwitanɨra ɨnyangi yɨɨtʉ yɨ Ɨkɨyaahudi. Nɨkakora umucha bhʉkʉngʼu kugwata amanarʉ ga bhabhaabha.
Nawe Mungu akandobhora nɨkɨɨrɨ kwibhurwa, akambɨrɨkɨra kʉbhɨgʉngi bhyazɨ, akatɨnɨra
kuhumburɨra chɨmbu Umwana waazɨ
arɨ. Akeenda kokorabhu, korereke nirwazɨ Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu igʉrʉ wu Umwana waazɨ kʉbhaatʉ bhanʉ bhatarɨ Abhayaahudi. Nɨtamʉhiryɨ abhaatʉ bha kʉndagɨrɨra kɨnʉ nɨraakore.
Nɨtaabhugirɨ nijɨ Yɨrusarɨɨmu kʉbhanʉ bhaankangatiirɨ kʉbha abhatumwa.
Nawe kɨnʉ nakʉrirɨ ni‑kuja mucharʉ cha Arabhiya. Akʉmara, nɨkagarʉka naatu mʉrʉbhɨri rwa Damɨɨsikʉ.
Hanʉ jahitirɨ imyaka ɨtatʉ, nɨkaja Yɨrusarɨɨmu korereke nirumanɨ na Peetero.
Nikiikara ɨwaazɨ sikʉ ikumi ni isaanʉ.
Nawe nɨtarʉʉzɨ abhatumwa abhandɨ, kuruushaku Yaakobho, umwabhʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu.
Mungu amɨnyirɨ amangʼana ganʉ nɨkʉbhaandɨkɨra gatarɨ ga rʉrɨmɨ!
Mmbe, ribhaga ɨrɨndɨ nɨkaja mubhyarʉ bhya Siiriya na Kirikiya.
Ribhaga riyo, inyɨ nɨtaarɨ nɨmɨnyɨkɨɨnɨ kʉmasengerero ganʉ garɨ mucharʉ cha Yudeya.
Kɨnʉ bhaarɨ bhɨɨzɨ igʉrʉ waanɨ nɨ‑mangʼana ganʉ bhiigwirɨ, “Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ aatʉnyaakiryɨ mʉbhʉtangɨ, sikʉ zɨnʉ ahaarwaza ubhwisirirya bhuryabhurya bhʉnʉ ɨɨndirɨ kubhuricha!”
Mmbe, bhakakumya Mungu igʉrʉ wa ganʉ aarɨ ankʉrɨɨrɨ.
